summary: Prospective independently versioned FS.GG.Telemetry.Host 0.6.0 bundles the current Store14 implementation and accepts provider-usage-observation/1 through the existing authenticated generic receipt route. Envelope and receipt ABI remain unchanged. Passive facts retain authenticated owner checks, canonical-only attribution and corrections; qualified item totals do not include them. The fixed Store14 candidate, artifact verifier and eight-effect publisher bind telemetry-host/v0.6.0 and journal12. Candidate qualification requires eligible Linux x64, matching installed-package evidence and actual passive receipt correction/restore controls; a clean unsupported-storage refusal is not positive acceptance. Bounded local compilation and HTTP/schema controls passed; full hosted, candidate, downloaded-package and service adoption remain separate pending gates. Published Host 0.5.0 and its original schema14 source/journal11, prior 0.4 profiles and every immutable artifact remain unchanged. This is independent of coherent CLI/Kit/Drivers publication and active installed selection. Existing TLS and bearer API capability does not establish actual receiver endpoint, trust, enrollment, backup or readiness. Home owns stable receiver metadata; local producer capture remains useful without receiver credentials. Registry declarations, source review and local controls do not authorize publication or establish receiver adoption.
title: Host 0.6 source accepts partial passive usage; receiver adoption is separate
